page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m4.2xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine instance configured with dedicated compute resources. It features 8 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

For accelerated workloads, the instance includes a single NVIDIA GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this server type, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The 4 GB VRAM capacity and 4 Gbps network baseline represent potential constraints for larger model training or high-throughput data ingestion.

The hardware profile offers an entry-level GPU acceleration option combined with dedicated AMD EPYC CPU cores. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring light GPU acceleration without the overhead of high-end enterprise GPUs. Suitable workloads include lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding, entry-level 3D rendering, and general-purpose applications that benefit from hardware-accelerated processing.

The instance does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. This hardware configuration provides a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU alongside entry-level GPU acceleration. It is designed for workloads such as lightweight machine learning inference, video encoding, and graphics-accelerated applications that require dedicated CPU resources and modest GPU compute capabilities without the cost of high-end accelerator hardware.
